narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The full turn does not count, so there are only three angles of symmetry.
<bookmark mark='full'/>After the full turn every corner is back in its own place, and the square fits.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A turn that makes the square fit its outline must be counted, whatever its size.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says the full turn does not count, so there are only three; the tile turns all the way round and each corner is back in its own place; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Turn a shape about its centre, and count every turn after which it fits itself.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A card is longer than it is wide. Does a quarter turn about its centre make it fit?
